items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 23 at 1:50PM EDT until October 26 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with some gusts up to 35 kt
and seas 6 to 9 ft expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
